item.title: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank: the situation
item.description:
Israeli forces continue raids in occupied West West Bank villages, targeting NGOs and staff, while settlers set fire to a mosque and attacked olive harvesters. In Gaza, Israel blocked construction of a key base created by the Trump peace board and carried out air strikes that killed a Palestinian woman in Gaza City and rescued a girl from a burning apartment. Former Israeli security chief and an ex-Shin Bet chief have each filed defamation suits against Netanyahu over the October 7 events. Kamala Harris said President Biden should have acted to stop Israel's conduct in Gaza. The conflict caused 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
